messages:
ashley: quick check-in on cache handoff semantics when we enable 4-bit kernels. need to lock down the minimal runtime invariants and what telemetry we surface during transition.

miguel: good call. which invariants are you thinking about? fingerprint match? cache_version? kernel_compat tag?

ashley: all three. concrete proposal: runtime requires (artifact_fingerprint, cache_format_version, kernel_tag) to match profile. if mismatch -> block apply and emit event `precision_apply_blocked`.

sam: agree on blocking. add a soft-fail mode for canaries: emit `precision_mismatch_warn` but let canary requests proceed if ops enable `allow_mismatch_in_canary=true` (only for user-sampled canary routes).

olivia: telemetry-wise we should emit per-request `precision_used` and a boolean `kv_requant_performed`. also need `kv_requant_mode` (inline|background) and `kv_migration_checkpoint` id.

ashley: note: some 4-bit kernels use packed nibbles + per-block scales. migration may need to re-quantize existing KV. prefer async background migration with atomic swap to avoid p99 spikes.

sam: background job is fine, but add `migration_backpressure` state machine: normal | throttled | paused. control-plane should set it based on `migration_queue_len` and `p95_latency_ms`.

miguel: how do we trace a specific regression back to an artifact? need the artifact_fingerprint in all request logs for the lifespan of the cache.

olivia: yep include `artifact_fingerprint` in the request-level trace and in the console timeline. also add `profile_apply_latency_ms` histogram.

qa-bot: QA note: we need deterministic holdout prompts and a golden baseline. we'll compute `sample_diff_score` and `embedding_cosine_shift`. seed/prompt list will be checked into repo.

ashley: workflow: 1) preflight lint in control-plane (fail on missing scale_table, absent fingerprint). 2) runtime check (blocked if fingerprint mismatch). 3) canary with `allow_mismatch_in_canary` if needed. 4) background kv migration with checkpoints.

sam: about cache metadata: add `cache_meta.json` with fields: `cache_format_version`, `artifact_fingerprint`, `created_by_profile_id`, and a `migration_state`. runtime reads this at load and refuses incompatible kernels.

miguel: API surface: add `precision_profile_id` to the InferenceRequest (string). keep legacy selector for backwards compat. prefer profile_id when present.

ashley: we'll avoid changing the decoding/response path. just route->kernel selection earlier in the request lifecycle so downstream code stays the same.

olivia: add audit trail: control-plane stores `profile_rollout_events` (who, when, region, percent). per-tenant opt-out flag should be respected at routing time.

ops-bot: deploy-tag: canary/4bit-cache-handshake started for service=lm-gateway region=us-west2 by ashley at 2024-12-03T11:08:22Z

sam: regression handling: if `sample_diff_score` exceeds threshold we should first pause canary, then auto-fallback affected routes to int8, and finally page if alert persists. document rollout->rollback flow in ops playbook.

miguel: linting: control-plane preflight should run `profile_lint` and `artifact_integrity_check` (match manifest fingerprint vs artifact). fail deploy on mismatch.

olivia: observability: console should aggregate by `artifact_fingerprint` and `kernel_tag`. provide a quick filter to show recent `precision_fallback_trigger` events for that artifact.

ashley: one more: require model-compiler to publish `quant_meta.tar.gz` containing `scale_tables/`, `block_sizes.json`, and `fingerprint.txt`. runtime will verify presence before applying profile.

infra-bot: reminder: re-quant jobs will increase GPU mem and io. add host-level limits `max_concurrent_requant_jobs` and a global `migration_circuit_breaker` percentage to stop new migrations under pressure.

sam: also track `precision_change_count` per-request (how many times we changed precision mid-request). high values indicate instability.

qa-bot: evaluation hooks: produce `sample_diff_abs`, `sample_diff_rel`, `embedding_shift_pct`, `token_confidence_drift`. emit these as telemetry events after evaluation runs.

ashley: i'll add a short RFC follow-up documenting: runtime invariants, cache metadata schema, preflight lint rules, telemetry event names, migration states, and ops rollback steps. will link PR here.

miguel: please include recommended default thresholds for sample_diff and embedding shift in the doc so ops/QA have a starting point.

ashley: will do. thanks everyone. closing this sync; individual follow-ups for migration jobs, lint rules, and console UI will be new threads. :thumbsup:
